cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, json, ipaddress
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from common import validate, Invalid
DOC=ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/32')
def base_job(**kw):
    job={'version':3,'seed':'a-b_C','leases':[],'services':[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[0],
         'captures':[],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
    job.update(kw); return job

# 1) uppercase / equal-to-doc prefix offers, /128, alternate address spellings
job=base_job(offers=[{'id':'o1','time':0,'service':'s','prefix':'2001:0DB8::/32','capacity':4096,
                      'cost':10**9,'group':'g','requests':[]}],
             offer_quotas=[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':0}])
ctx=validate(job); print('offer /32 uppercase + capacity0 ok', ctx['offers']['o1']['network'])
job['offers'][0]['prefix']='2001:db8:0:0:0:0:0:1/128'
print('/128 ok', validate(job)['offers']['o1']['network'])
# 2) maximal manifest boundary: exactly 65536 planned targets
leases=[{'id':'L%04d'%i,'prefix':str(ipaddress.IPv6Network((int(DOC.network_address)+((i+1)<<72),56))),
         'start':0,'end':10**12+1,'subnets':[0],'low_count':31} for i in range(2048)]
ctx=validate(base_job(leases=leases, queries=[0,1,2,3]))
print('2048 leases / 65536 targets accepted:', len(ctx['leases']))
# one more target must be rejected
leases.append({'id':'L9999','prefix':str(ipaddress.IPv6Network((int(DOC.network_address)+(999999<<72),56))),
               'start':0,'end':5,'subnets':[0],'low_count':31})
try:
    validate(base_job(leases=leases)); print('ERROR: over budget accepted')
except Invalid as e: print('over-budget rejected ok:', e)
# 3) 4096 quota nodes with a 32-deep chain, 4096 requests, 8192 offers, 262144 pairs
nodes=[{'id':'Q%d'%i,'parent':('Q%d'%(i-1)) if i and i%32 else None,'capacity':4096} for i in range(4096)]
reqs=[{'id':'R%d'%i,'at':0,'lease':'L0000','target':'2001:db8:0:%x::1'%(i+1),'service':'s','group':'Q4095'} for i in range(4096)]
print('request targets in doc range:', all(ipaddress.IPv6Address(r['target']) in DOC for r in reqs))
offers=[{'id':'F%d'%i,'time':0,'service':'s','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':4096,'cost':0,
         'group':'Q%d'%(i%4096),'requests':[('R%d'%((i*32+j)%4096)) for j in range(32)]} for i in range(8192)]
ctx=validate(base_job(leases=leases[:1], requests=reqs, offers=offers, request_quotas=nodes, offer_quotas=nodes))
print('max metadata accepted: requests %d offers %d pairs %d' % (len(ctx['requests']), len(ctx['offers']),
      sum(len(o['requests']) for o in ctx['offers'].values())))
